The De Bethune DB28 Digitale (DB28DN) manual wind watch, features a 45mm titanium case surrounding a silver dial on a royal blue alligator strap with a titanium tang buckle. Functions include jumping hours, scrolling minutes and moonphase. This watch comes complete with the original box and papers. This De Bethune watch also measures 13.4mm in thickness and 58mm from lug-to-lug.
